title: Chintamani Library v2.8.0 — Password Fix, Single Splash, Member Sync & Direct APK Download
releaseNotes: CRITICAL AUTH FIX: Removed all hardcoded bypass passwords (Admin@1234, CML6050, Mani6050) from backend and mobile — authentication is now 100% secure
CHANGE PASSWORD: Added real /auth/change-password API endpoint — password changes now persist to the cloud database
SINGLE SPLASH SCREEN: Fixed double loading screen after login using refreshListenable router pattern — one clean transition
SEAT BRANCH FIX: Mehdawal UUID (a45d90e2-...) now correctly resolves to M-prefix seats; backend uses resolveBranchInfo for all seat queries
MEMBER SYNC: Backend members now sync to local cache on every successful fetch, keeping offline view consistent with cloud
PAGINATED RESPONSE FIX: TransformInterceptor now preserves total/page/limit from paginated endpoints
DIRECT APK INSTALL: Update button now downloads and installs APK directly in-app without opening GitHub browser
